Ruled: A — the on/off switch of positions, permission sets and sharing rules moves with the item into Studio; Setup keeps only the people pages.

Maintainer, in this seat's direct session (epic PM for #28236), verbatim: 「M-1（#28559）裁 A：岗位、权限集、共享规则的启停开关随项目搬到 Studio，Setup 只留人员相关的页面。」

**What the ruling binds** (Governing text: ADR-0146 D1, D4, D7):
- The deployment switch served by `packages/runtime/src/domains/catalog-activation.ts` is offered on the item page in Studio (the Access pillar / the All metadata area, #28561), the way D4 put the flow switch on the item. The door, its gate and its readings are unchanged; only the surface moves.
- Setup keeps the people pages: position holders and permission-set assignment (#28241, D7). D7's ⛔ is met, because the switch has a home in Studio before the catalog routes retire.
- #28578 (N-28) item 2 retires all four `?scope=environment` catalog entries and routes, with redirects into #28561's area, once the switch is reachable there. No ADR carve-out is needed. D1 ("Setup carries no metadata editor and no metadata catalog") holds as written.
- Accepted cost: an administrator with `setup.access` but no `studio.access` switches these items in Studio. The release note says so.

The decision is executed by #28578; this card closes as completed.
